Reading list 
prepared by Univ.-Prof. Dr. Judit Simon 
 
Health Service Administration – Grundlagen der Gesundheitsökonomie 
1. Meltzer MI, Introduction to health economics for physicians, Lancet, 2001, 358: 993-98 
2. Kernick DP, Introduction to health economics for the medical practitioner, Postgrad Med J, 
2003, 79:147–150. 
3. Cost-Effectiveness in Health and Medicine by Gold MR, Gold SR, Weinstein MC, Oxford 
University Press, 1996 
4. Economics of Health Care Financing: The visible hand, 2nd edition by Donaldson C, Gerard K, 
Palgrave MacMillan, 2005 
5. Decision Modelling for Health Economic Evaluation by Briggs A, Claxton K, Sculpher M, Oxford 
University Press, 2006 
6. Applied Methods of Cost-Effectiveness Analysis in Health Care by Gray AM, Clarke PM, et al. 
Oxford University Press, 2011 
7. Methods for the economic evaluation of health care programmes, 4th Edition, by Drummond M, 
Sculpher MJ, et al, Oxford University Press, 2015 
8. Gesundheitsökonomie by Hajen L, Paetow H, Schumacher H, Verlag W. Kohlhammer, 2013 
9. Gesundheitsökonomie by Lauterbach KW, Stock S, Brunner H, Verlag Hans Huber, 2013 
10. Simon J, Anand P, Gray A, Rugkåsa J, Yeeles K, and Burns T (2013) Operationalising the capability 
approach for outcome measurement in mental health research. Social Science & Medicine, 
98:187–196. doi: 10.1016/ j.socscimed.2013.09.019 
11. Rencz F, Gulácsi L, Drummond M, Golicki D, Prevolnik Rupel V, Simon J, Stolk EA, Brodszky V, Baji 
P, Závada J, Petrova G, Rotar A, Péntek M (2016): EQ-5D in Central and Eastern Europe: 2000-
2015. Quality of Life Research, 19(5):525-530. 19(5):525-530 DOI: 10.1007/s11136-016-1375-6 
12. Mayer S, Kiss N, Łaszewska A, Simon J, Costing evidence for health care decision-making in 
Austria: A systematic review. PLOS ONE, 2017, 12(8): e0183116.  
13. Mayer S, Fischer C, Zechmeister-Koss I, Ostermann H, Simon J. Are unit costs the same? A case 
study comparing different valuation methods for unit cost calculation of general practitioner 
consultations. Value Health. 2020 Sep 1;23(9):1142–1148. DOI: 10.1016/j.jval.2020.06.001 
14. Berger M, Mayer S, Simon J. A novel set of Austrian reference unit costs for comprehensive 
societal perspectives consistent with latest European costing methods for economic evaluations. 
Wien Klin Wochenschr. 2022 Dec. DOI: 10.1007/s00508-022-02128-6 
15. Laszewska A, …, Simon J. Cost-effectiveness of pramipexole augmentation for acute phase and 
maintenance therapy of treatment-resistant depression compared to placebo augmentation: 
economic evaluation of the PAX-D randomised controlled trial. Lancet Regional Health Europe, 
2025, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.lanepe.2025.101533 
16. Consolidated CHEERS checklist: Value Health. 2022;25(1):3-9. PMID: 35031096

International Health Economics – Vergleich internationaler Gesundheitssysteme 
1. Das Gesundheitswesen im internationalen Vergleich. Kapitel 1.1: Eine Typologie der 
Gesundheitssysteme. Kapitel 3: Die Gesundheitsausgaben und ihre Finanzierung by Schölkopf 
M, Medizinisch Wissenschaftliche Verlagsgesellschaft, 2010 
2. Bachner et al., Austria: Health System Review, Health Systems in Transition, 2018, 20(3) 
3. OECD, Health at a Glance series. https://www.oecd-ilibrary.org/social-issues-migration-
health/health-at-a-glance_19991312 
4. OECD (2014), OECD Gesundheitsdaten 2014: Österreich im Vergleich, abrufbar unter: 
http://www.oecd.org/els/health-systems/Briefing-Note-OSTERREICH-2014-in-German.pdf. 
5. Perić N, Hofmarcher-Holzhacker M M, Simon J, Health system performance assessment 
landscape at the EU level: A focused synthesis of actors and actions. Archives of Public Health, 
2017: 75(5) 
6. Perić N, Hofmarcher-Holzhacker M M, Simon J, Headline indicators for monitoring the 
performance of health systems: findings from the european Health Systems_Indicator (euHS_I) 
survey. Archives of Public Health, 2018; 76:32. 
7. IQAir. World Air Quality Report 2023.
